exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.instructions_short: Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides. Jump while simultaneously spreading your feet shoulder-width apart and raising your arms overhead. Jump again to return to the starting position. Keep your movements fluid and rhythmic. Perform for 30-60 seconds to elevate heart rate.
form_cues: Land with soft knees to reduce impact
Breathe steadily and don't hold your breath

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instructions_short: Rotate arms in circular motions to loosen shoulders
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Make small circular motions forward for 15-20 rotations, then reverse direction. Gradually increase the size of the circles. Perform 30-45 seconds total.
form_cues: Keep shoulders relaxed and away from ears
Feel the shoulder joint warming up

exercises.name: Hip Rotations
exercises.instructions_short: Rotate hips in circular motions
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width apart and place hands on hips. Rotate your hips in large circles, moving forward, then to the side, then back, then to the other side. Perform 10-15 rotations in one direction, then reverse. This prepares your hips and lower back for boxing movements.
form_cues: Keep your upper body relatively still
Move from the hips, not the knees

exercises.name: Light Shadowboxing
exercises.instructions_short: Throw light punches while moving around with purpose
exercises.instructions_detailed: Move around your space while throwing light jabs, crosses, and hooks at an imaginary opponent. Keep movements controlled and focus on footwork and technique rather than power. Move in different directions and maintain a boxing stance. Perform for 1-2 minutes at a relaxed pace.
form_cues: Keep hands up to protect your face

exercises.name: Jump Rope Warm-up
exercises.instructions_short: Jump rope at a steady, sustainable pace
exercises.instructions_detailed: Hold the rope handles at waist height and jump continuously using a rhythmic, bouncy motion. Keep your shoulders relaxed and let your wrists do most of the work. Land on the balls of your feet and keep your body upright. Start slowly and gradually increase pace. Perform for 1-2 minutes.
form_cues: Stay on the balls of your feet
Keep elbows close to your body

exercises.name: Jab Practice
exercises.instructions_short: Extend your lead arm straight forward with speed and precision
exercises.instructions_detailed: From a boxing stance with your lead foot forward, extend your lead arm straight forward, rotating your shoulder and hip. Snap the jab back to your face quickly. Repeat for multiple reps, focusing on speed, accuracy, and returning to guard position. Perform slow and controlled reps to learn proper form.
form_cues: Rotate your shoulder and hip into the punch
Snap the punch back to your face
Keep your other hand protecting your face

exercises.name: Cross Practice
exercises.instructions_short: Drive your rear hand straight forward with power and hip rotation
exercises.instructions_detailed: From a boxing stance, drive your rear hand forward while rotating your hips and shoulders. The cross comes from your back leg and core, not just your arm. Your front shoulder should protect your chin as you throw. Snap the punch back to guard position. Practice with control and precision.
form_cues: Power comes from your legs and core
Keep your front hand up for defense

exercises.name: Lead Hook Practice
exercises.instructions_short: Throw a curved punch with your lead arm to the side
exercises.instructions_detailed: From a boxing stance, bend your lead arm at a 90-degree angle and rotate your hips and shoulders to swing it in an arc toward an imaginary opponent at the side. Your elbow stays at shoulder height. Generate power from your legs and core rotation, not just your arm. Return to guard with control.
form_cues: Keep your elbow at shoulder height

exercises.name: Rear Hook Practice
exercises.instructions_short: Throw a powerful curved punch with your rear arm
exercises.instructions_detailed: From a boxing stance, bend your rear arm at a 90-degree angle and rotate your hips and shoulders explosively to swing it in an arc. This is a powerful punch generated from your back leg and core. Keep your lead hand protecting your face. Pivot on your back foot for maximum power and control.
form_cues: Keep your lead hand up for defense

exercises.name: Lead Uppercut Practice
exercises.instructions_short: Drive your lead fist upward with an explosive hip and shoulder rotation
exercises.instructions_detailed: From a boxing stance, bend your lead arm and drive it upward in a straight line, rotating your hips and shoulders. The uppercut is generated from your legs and torso. Keep your elbow slightly bent and drive through your opponent's center line. Return quickly to guard position.
form_cues: Rotate your hips and shoulders upward
Keep your rear hand protecting your face
Drive straight up, not at an angle

exercises.name: Rear Uppercut Practice
exercises.instructions_short: Drive your rear fist upward with explosive power
exercises.instructions_detailed: From a boxing stance, bend your rear arm and explosively drive it upward while rotating your hips and shoulders. This is one of the most powerful punches in boxing. Generate all power from your legs and core rotation. Keep proper balance and return to guard.
form_cues: Keep your knees bent for power

exercises.name: 1-2 Combination
exercises.instructions_short: Throw a jab followed immediately by a cross
exercises.instructions_detailed: Throw your lead hand jab straight forward, then immediately follow with a rear hand cross. The punches flow naturally from one to the other. The jab sets up the cross and creates the opening. Flow smoothly from jab to cross without dropping your hands. Practice for continuous combinations.
form_cues: Snap both hands back to guard
Rotate your hips with each punch

exercises.name: 1-2-3 Combination
exercises.instructions_short: Throw a jab, cross, then lead hook in rapid succession
exercises.instructions_detailed: Start with a lead hand jab, follow with a rear hand cross, then immediately throw a lead hook. All three punches flow together in one fluid combination. Each punch sets up the next. Return to guard position and repeat. This combination builds coordination and timing.
form_cues: Flow smoothly from punch to punch
Keep your chin tucked and hands up

exercises.name: Basic Footwork Drills
exercises.instructions_short: Practice moving forward, backward, and side-to-side in boxing stance
exercises.instructions_detailed: From your boxing stance, practice stepping forward one foot at a time while maintaining your stance. Then practice moving backward by stepping with your back foot first. Move side-to-side with quick, controlled steps. Keep your hands up and maintain balance throughout. Practice for 2-3 minutes.
form_cues: Lead foot moves first when advancing
Back foot moves first when retreating
Keep hands up at all times

exercises.name: Defensive Head Movement
exercises.instructions_short: Practice slipping, rolling, and bobbing to evade imaginary punches
exercises.instructions_detailed: From your boxing stance, practice slipping by moving your head slightly off the center line. Roll your shoulders under imaginary punches. Bob and weave by bending your knees and moving your head in circular motions. Combine these movements to develop defensive awareness. Maintain your stance throughout.
form_cues: Keep your hands up while moving

exercises.name: Heavy Bag Power Rounds
exercises.instructions_short: Throw powerful combinations on the heavy bag with full intensity
exercises.instructions_detailed: Work the heavy bag with powerful jabs, crosses, hooks, and combinations. Focus on generating maximum power from your hips and core. Throw combinations for 2-3 minutes, rest for 1 minute, then repeat for multiple rounds. This develops power and explosiveness while conditioning your body.
form_cues: Maintain proper form even at high intensity
Keep your hands up between combinations

exercises.name: Heavy Bag Speed Combinations
exercises.instructions_short: Throw rapid, light combinations on the heavy bag with speed emphasis
exercises.instructions_detailed: Work the heavy bag with rapid combinations at higher speed and lower intensity. Focus on hand speed, accuracy, and combination flow. Use shorter, snappier punches. Work for 2-3 minute rounds with 1 minute rest. This develops hand speed, accuracy, and cardiovascular endurance.
form_cues: Keep proper form at high speed

exercises.name: Heavy Bag HIIT Intervals
exercises.instructions_short: Alternate between high intensity and low intensity work on the bag
exercises.instructions_detailed: Work the heavy bag at maximum intensity for 30 seconds, then slow your pace for 30 seconds recovery. Repeat this pattern for 8-10 rounds. This high-intensity interval training builds explosive power, speed, and cardiovascular conditioning while maximizing calorie burn.

exercises.name: Heavy Bag Technique Focus
exercises.instructions_short: Practice specific punches and combinations on the heavy bag with controlled form
exercises.instructions_detailed: Work the heavy bag with emphasis on proper form and technique. Practice specific punches like jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts individually, then in combinations. Move around the bag, use footwork, and maintain your defensive stance. Perform for 3-5 minute rounds.
form_cues: Prioritize form over power and speed
Move with purpose around the bag

exercises.name: Heavy Bag Endurance Rounds
exercises.instructions_short: Work the heavy bag at a steady, sustainable pace for extended duration
exercises.instructions_detailed: Work the heavy bag continuously at a moderate pace for 5-10 minute rounds. Maintain consistent output without going all-out. This builds aerobic capacity and mental toughness. The goal is to maintain technique and pace over extended periods. Perfect for building fighting endurance.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions_short: Squat, push your legs back, do a push-up, then jump up
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down and place your hands on the ground. Jump your feet back into a plank position. Perform a push-up, then jump your feet back toward your hands. Explosively jump up with your hands overhead. This full-body exercise builds strength and conditioning.
form_cues: Keep a straight line from head to heels in plank
Move through each phase with control

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions_short: From a plank position, alternately drive your knees toward your chest
exercises.instructions_detailed: Get into a plank position with hands under shoulders. Keeping your body straight, alternately drive your knees toward your chest in a running motion. Keep your hips level and core tight. Move quickly and rhythmically for 30-60 seconds per set. This builds core strength and cardiovascular conditioning.
form_cues: Keep your hips level and core tight

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.instructions_short: Run in place, bringing your knees up to hip height
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand upright and run in place, driving your knees up to hip height with each step. Move at a steady, controlled pace or increase speed for more intensity. Keep your arms pumping and maintain an upright posture. Perform for 30-60 seconds per set.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.instructions_short: Squat down then explosively jump upward
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and hips. Explosively jump upward, extending your legs fully. Land softly back into a squat position and repeat. Perform for 30-45 seconds per set. This builds leg power essential for boxing.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.instructions_short: Hold a straight line position on your forearms and toes
exercises.instructions_detailed: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms and toes. Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels. Engage your core and avoid letting your hips sag. Breathe steadily and hold for 30-60 seconds. Rest and repeat for multiple sets.
form_cues: Maintain a straight line from head to heels
Keep your core tight and engaged

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.instructions_short: Sit with bent knees and rotate your torso side-to-side
exercises.instructions_detailed: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet slightly off the ground. Lean back slightly and clasp your hands together. Rotate your torso to the right, touching the ground beside you, then rotate to the left. Move continuously for 30-45 seconds. This strengthens your core and improves rotational power for punching.
form_cues: Keep your feet off the ground
Rotate from your core, not your arms

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing with Movement
exercises.instructions_short: Throw combinations while moving around with footwork and speed
exercises.instructions_detailed: Move around your space while throwing combinations at varying speeds and intensities. Incorporate footwork, angles, and directional changes. Practice different combinations like 1-2s, 1-2-3s, and hooks. Work for 2-3 minute rounds with brief rest periods. This combines cardio, technique, and footwork training.

exercises.name: Lateral Shuffles
exercises.instructions_short: Shuffle side-to-side in quick, controlled steps
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in an athletic stance. Shuffle quickly to the right for 5-10 steps, then shuffle back to the left. Keep your knees bent and chest up. Move at a controlled, sustainable pace for 30-60 seconds. This builds lateral agility and conditioning.
form_cues: Keep your feet light and quick

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions_short: Lower your body by bending your arms, then push back up
exercises.instructions_detailed: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the ground. Push yourself back up to the starting position. Keep your body in a straight line throughout. Perform for 8-15 reps per set.
form_cues: Maintain a straight line from head to heels
Lower your entire body as one unit

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.instructions_short: Lie on your back and alternately bring your elbows to your knees
exercises.instructions_detailed: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head. Bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending your right leg. Return to start and repeat on the other side. Move continuously in a bicycle pedaling motion for 30-45 seconds. This effectively targets your core and rotational muscles.

exercises.name: Light Shadowboxing Cool-down
exercises.instructions_short: Throw very light, slow punches while moving gently around
exercises.instructions_detailed: Move around slowly while throwing very light, controlled punches. Focus on relaxation and proper form rather than speed or power. Move at a comfortable pace and reduce intensity significantly. Perform for 2-3 minutes to bring your heart rate down gradually while maintaining muscle engagement.

exercises.name: Shoulder Stretch
exercises.instructions_short: Pull one arm across your body to stretch the shoulder
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand or sit upright. Bring your right arm across your body at shoulder height. Use your left hand to gently pull your right elbow toward your chest. Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a stretch in your shoulder. Breathe deeply throughout. Switch sides and repeat.
form_cues: Feel the stretch in your shoulder

exercises.name: Tricep Stretch
exercises.instructions_short: Reach one arm overhead and bend it, using your other hand to gently push your elbow
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand upright and reach your right arm overhead, bending your elbow so your hand comes down behind your head. Use your left hand to gently push your right elbow behind your head. You should feel a stretch along the back of your arm. Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe deeply. Repeat on the other side.
form_cues: Feel the stretch in your tricep

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instructions_short: Step one foot forward into a lunge position and hold
exercises.instructions_detailed: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee toward the ground, creating a lunge position. Keep your torso upright and push your hips forward slightly. You should feel a stretch in the front of your left hip. Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply. Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: Deep Breathing Exercise
exercises.instructions_short: Take slow, deep breaths to calm your nervous system
exercises.instructions_detailed: Stand or sit comfortably with your back straight. Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4, hold for a count of 4, then exhale slowly through your mouth for a count of 4. Repeat this cycle 10-15 times. This breathing exercise activates your parasympathetic nervous system, promoting recovery and relaxation after your workout.
